summary: Full-extraction pass over 12 stored Panamanian documents: five MICI press releases, the MICI DE 722 programme page and six SNM residence-permit statistics files (2010-2021 to Jan-Aug 2026). Most programme numbers were already in the tables; this pass adds the 2010-2021 Total column, the Jan-Aug 2026 monthly approvals for three categories, and the monthly application rates quoted by MICI's vice-minister in April 2026.

observations.notes: Applications per month when the current administration began, quoted from vice-minister Eduardo Arango. The release gives no month: the administration took office on 1 July 2024, so 2024-07 is our reading, not printed (period_basis unspecified). Range 10-12 per month; MICI programme applications (investment-certificate requests), not SNM permits.

observations.notes: Applications per month 'today' (statement reported on 23 Apr 2026), quoted from vice-minister Eduardo Arango. Lower bound ('superar las 30'): more than 30 a month. Which months are meant is not stated. MICI programme applications.

ledger.contains: MICI year-end 2025 results release. In scope: Qualified Investor programme, 613 certificates since creation and USD 309.8 million cumulative investment (both already in the tables), and the 2025 digital platform (already event e-a2f73f8166 from the 16 Dec 2025 release). The rest is out of scope: exports (USD 835 million / 1,098 million), free zones, SEM regime, audiovisual industry, MERCOSUR, Hecho en Panamá, Bocas del Toro, SIECA. Nothing new added.

MICI release on presenting the Qualified Investor programme to law firms and advisers (with Caja de Ahorros). Already in the tables: over 700 investors approved and over USD 350 million invested (vice-minister's claim). Added: applications per month, 10-12 when the administration began, over 30 now, peak of 38 in one month (3 rows, claims). Restates the route minimums (real estate from USD 300,000, securities 500,000, fixed deposit 750,000): these match the decree terms already in program_terms (DE 722 as amended by DE 193 of 2024), so no duplicate rule rows. No nationality or other splits.

MICI release: certificates July 2025-June 2026 (268, B/.113.6 million) and July 2024-June 2025 (193, over B/.90.1 million); route shares of certificates for both periods (real estate, deposit, securities). All already in the tables. Also prints the differences (75 more certificates, over B/.23.4 million more investment), not added because they are only the differences of rows already held; says the new platform 'doubled' certificates per month (words, no number); lists applicants' countries (USA, Canada, Colombia, Mexico, Brazil, Spain, Germany, Switzerland, Russia, China) without counts. Nothing new added.

MICI release on the new Qualified Investor decree (DE 17 of 8 Sept 2026): B/.300,000 for first-sale property, B/.500,000 for resale property, B/.500,000 deposits at Banco Nacional or Caja de Ahorros, wider securities options. These rules and the event are already in program_terms/events from the gazette (pan-go-de17-2026), so no duplicate rows. Certificate counts and investment for July 2024-June 2025 and July 2025-June 2026 already in the tables. Nothing new added.

MICI release on DE 17 of 2026 at the groundbreaking of a Mercan Group residential project. Already in the tables: 268 certificates / B/.113.6 million (Jul 2025-Jun 2026), 193 / over B/.90.1 million (previous period), real estate 87.3% of certificates. DE 17 amounts already in program_terms from the gazette. Out of scope: the Mercan Group project (48-storey tower, 200 apartments, delivery 2028, Mercan plan of about B/.200 million), which the release does not say is a qualifying project or count of programme investment. Nothing new added.

Undated MICI programme page for DE 722 (titled 'Decreto ejecutivo 722-antes'): purpose, investment forms, minimums ($500,000 free of liens; USD 300,000 real estate under DE 109 of 2022 until 15 Oct 2024; $500,000 securities; USD 750,000 fixed deposit), benefits (permanent residence, filing before entry, approval in 30 working days, SNM special window). All these rules are already in program_terms from the decrees (DE 722, DE 109, DE 193); the 30 working days is a legal maximum, already t-a422c5cd9e. No statistics. Nothing new added.

SNM residence permits 2010-2021 (revised to 31 Dec 2021), 3 pages: decided/approved/denied by year (all categories); approved by sex, by permit type, by category (68 categories, Total + yearly columns) and by age group; charts of the same. In scope: category rows Países Amigos, Inversionista de Macroempresa and the four Solvencia Propia rows; all yearly values were already in the tables, the 2010-2021 Total column (6 rows) added now. Category table checked: rows add up to the printed total in every year, and each in-scope row's years add up to its Total. Sex, type and age tables cover all permits (out of scope). No nationality table.
